description_en: Lists the registered knowledge sources for a specified knowledge base with pagination
description_zh: 分页查询指定知识库已登记的知识来源
name: ListKnowledgeSources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by source type
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results

Code.description_en: The business error code. This code is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. If no next page exists, the value is null
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标；没有下一页时为 null

Sources.description_en: The knowledge sources that you have permission to read on the current page
Sources.description_zh: 本页有权读取的知识对象

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds

CreateUser.description_en: The creator. This field is written by the server

DataSource.description_en: The data source information. This field is available only when Type is set to DATA_SOURCE

DataSourceId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks data source. The server uses this ID to resolve the workspace, environment, and data source type
DataSourceId.description_zh: DataWorks 数据源 ID；服务端据此解析所属工作空间、环境和数据源类型

Description.description_en: The optional description of the purpose

Document.description_en: The document information. This field is available only when Type is set to DOCUMENT

ConnectorType.description_en: The connector type. Valid values: DINGTALK, FEISHU, LARK, WECOM, or YUQUE. The connector type cannot be changed after the source is created
ConnectorType.description_zh: DINGTALK、FEISHU、LARK、WECOM 或 YUQUE；创建后不可改变

CredentialConfigured.description_en: Indicates whether the credentials required by the connector are configured. This field is read-only, and the credential content or ciphertext is not returned
CredentialConfigured.description_zh: 是否已配置连接器所需凭证；只读，不返回凭证内容或密文

DingTalk.description_en: The DingTalk configuration. This field is available only when the connector type is DingTalk

AppId.description_en: The Feishu or Lark application ID. This is not the AppSecret
AppId.description_zh: Feishu/Lark 应用 ID；不是 AppSecret

SourceUrls.description_en: The URLs of the knowledge bases, spaces, or documents selected for this connector. The actual allowed scope is determined by the connector and authorization
SourceUrls.description_zh: 该连接器选定的知识库、空间或文档 URL；实际允许的范围由连接器及授权决定

WeCom.description_en: The WeCom configuration. This field is available only when the connector type is WeCom

BotId.description_en: The ID of the WeCom bot

Spaces.description_en: The selected shared spaces, including their identities and display names
Spaces.description_zh: 已选共享空间及其身份、展示名称

SpaceId.description_en: The identity of the shared space

SpaceName.description_en: The display name verified by the server. This field is not used for identity verification
SpaceName.description_zh: 服务端校验后的展示名，不参与身份判断

Yuque.description_en: The Yuque configuration. This field is available only when the connector type is Yuque

Teams.description_en: The Yuque team configurations. Each team independently selects the synchronization scope
Teams.description_zh: 语雀团队配置；各团队独立选择同步范围

Host.description_en: The URL of the team site

SourceUrls.description_en: The URLs of the knowledge bases, spaces, or documents selected for this connector. The actual allowed scope is determined by the connector and authorization
SourceUrls.description_zh: 该连接器选定的知识库、空间或文档 URL；实际允许的范围由连接器及授权决定

items.description_en: The URLs of the knowledge bases, spaces, or documents selected for this connector. The actual allowed scope is determined by the connector and authorization
items.description_zh: 该连接器选定的知识库、空间或文档 URL；实际允许的范围由连接器及授权决定

TeamId.description_en: The team ID verified by the server
TeamId.description_zh: 服务端校验后的团队 ID

TeamLogin.description_en: The team logon name. This is read-only display information
TeamLogin.description_zh: 团队登录名，只读展示信息

TeamName.description_en: The team name. This is read-only display information
TeamName.description_zh: 团队名称，只读展示信息

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the source belongs. The source cannot be migrated to another knowledge base after it is created
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 所属知识库 ID；创建后不可迁移到其他知识库

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 最近修改时间，毫秒时间戳

Name.description_en: The name used to identify the source

Project.description_en: The project information. This field is available only when Type is set to PROJECT

EnvType.description_en: The environment type. This optional field restricts the read environment to Dev or Prod. If this field is not specified, it does not mean that you have the permissions to read both environments
EnvType.description_zh: 可选，限定读取环境为 Dev 或 Prod；未限定时不表示可以越权读取两个环境

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. This field is used to locate the source
ProjectId.description_zh: DataWorks 工作空间 ID；来源定位字段

SourceId.description_en: The stable source ID generated by the service
SourceId.description_zh: 服务生成的稳定来源 ID

Type.description_en: The source type. Valid values: PROJECT (workspace), DATA_SOURCE (DataWorks data source), or DOCUMENT (external document source)
Type.description_zh: 来源类型：PROJECT（工作空间）、DATA_SOURCE（DataWorks 数据源）或 DOCUMENT（外部文档来源）

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
